title: Player persona: Utility weights and play habits (design 14.E)
description: personas/<slug>.json, shipped with Commentarii (game independent) or kept inside a bundle (game specific; a bundle persona wins over a shipped one with the same slug). Selected with --persona <slug>.

weights.description: Weight of each Utility consideration (spec/feature/engine.md). 0 turns a consideration off.

exploration_rate.description: Share of efficiency ticks on which the exploration bonus is active.

reaction_delay_ticks.description: The persona decides on the observation this many ticks old.

misplay_rate.description: Share of ticks on which the chosen action is fumbled (replaced by wait).

min_confidence.description: Least trusted tactic confidence used: authored (only) > derived > learned (all).

hysteresis.description: Utility added to the tactic whose behavior tree is still running.

links.description: IDs of the same persona in other LUDIARS services (Discutere, Histrio).
